scenario: Run Plasma with KWin VirtualBackend as an ordinary user outside the wheel group. Check the compositor, shell, applet models and services. Use a readiness minimum of 30 seconds before requesting normal logout. Capture Virtual-0 through ScreenShot2.CaptureScreen.
expected: The virtual output is 1280x1024 with active hardware composition. Qt Quick uses PowerVR, the compositor capture shows the desktop, and the session exits through normal logout.
observed: KWin 6.8.2 reported VirtualBackend at 1280x1024 and active OpenGL ES composition. PlasmaShell Qt Quick reported zink Vulkan 1.2 PowerVR B-Series BXM-4-64 MC1. Six applet models, Xwayland and Activities responded. Normal logout completed. ScreenShot2.CaptureScreen returned a 1280x1024 RGB PNG from Virtual-0. It showed the wallpaper, lower panel, clock and a notification. PNG SHA-256: e118920136b27075b1627c28085bba4685b01765201392428f52c0db7307ea50.
limits: The captured Plasma session used the graphics DTB at the original Zero 4 DTB filename. The offscreen graphics evidence records a separate successful reboot through the explicit graphics loader mode.
The compositor capture shows the virtual output on the physical board. A physical HDMI signal and monitor pixels remain unverified.
HDMI output, input, seat operation and long runs were not tested.
This test did not exercise the NPU. Zero 3W results have a separate scope.
